tasks.title: Modular Tileset System for Agent Rooms
tasks.detail:
## Summary
Implementasi modular tile-based room rendering system untuk Agent Control Center dashboard dengan sci-fi/office theme.

## Requirements
- Modular tiles (floor, wall, furniture) ~15-20 tiles dalam 256x256px sprite sheet
- 4 agent rooms: Builder Lab, QA Station, UI Studio, Command Center
- Auto-generate collision grid dari tile types
- Pathfinding visualization support
- CC0/public domain assets only (safe for production)

## Decisions Made
- Modular tiles > full room images (flexible, lightweight, dynamic)
- Tile size: 32x32px
- Theme: Sci-fi/office
- Performance target: <100ms render time

## Checklist
- [x] Search & download free CC0 modular tileset (sci-fi/office theme)
- [x] Create sprite sheet with floor, wall, furniture tiles (~15-20 tiles)
- [ ] Design room layouts: Builder Lab, QA Station, UI Studio, Command Center
- [ ] Generate tilemap JSON config untuk setiap room
- [ ] Implement collision grid auto-generation dari tile types
- [ ] Integrate tile renderer ke dashboard
- [ ] Test pathfinding visualization on tilemap
- [ ] User review & approval

tasks.title: Bailian Token Usage Webhook Server for Auto-Logging
tasks.detail:
## Summary
Setup webhook server untuk automatically log Bailian token usage dari OpenClaw completions ke dashboard.

## Requirements
- Track request count (18K/month quota)
- Track token usage per model
- Real-time dashboard update
- Auto-cleanup old entries

## Decisions Made
- Use webhook server (port 8765) instead of manual logging
- Store in memory/bailian-token-usage.json
- Dashboard polls every 30s

## Checklist
- [x] Install node-fetch dependency
- [x] Test webhook server locally
- [x] Configure OpenClaw to POST to webhook
- [x] Verify dashboard updates in real-time
- [x] Add error handling + retry logic
